name: Obsidian Atelier
fit: Watchmakers, fine jewellery, spirits, private banks, members' clubs: anything sold by craft and rarity
keywords: luxury watch horology gold black dark cormorant guilloche dial jewellery atelier premium
idea: A watchmaker's showroom after hours: black basalt ground, a guilloché dial that actually tells the time, and gold used the way a jeweller uses it, in thin lines and one lit headline word.
note: Live: the hands run on your clock. Move the pointer across the dial to move the reflection on the glass. Press Lume to charge the hands and markers.
borrowed: Dress-watch dials: engine-turned guilloché, applied baton markers, the red seconds hand, polished gold cases with a conic sheen, and the printed spec card in a boutique.
mood: Quiet, nocturnal, expensive. The headline is thin and large so gold can do the shouting in one word. Suits products that are already beautiful and few. Avoid for volume retail or anything with small data tables, where thin serifs on black will tire the eye.

type.meta: Display · Cormorant 300, italic 500 for the gilded word

motion: The gilded word breathes between Gold and a brighter champagne over 6s, `ease-in-out`.
Hands are driven from `Date` on `requestAnimationFrame`; with reduced motion the seconds hand ticks once a second.
The primary button floods with gold from the left in 600ms, `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`.
watchouts: Gold is a line colour. Fill large areas with it and the page becomes a casino.
Keep body copy at 15px or above and Smoke or lighter; Cormorant thins out badly at small sizes on black.
Only one gilded word per screen.
